options.content:
### Infrastructure Overview

**Did this board earn its place on your screen?** A rating on [its grafana.com page](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/25798/) takes two clicks and is the only thing that helps the next person find it. A [star on the repo](https://github.com/Fractal-Techware/grafana-dashboards?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=infra-overview) does the same on GitHub.

Free and MIT-licensed, from Fractal Techware. The source, a Docker Compose demo stack that generates sample data, and the other free boards: [github.com/Fractal-Techware/grafana-dashboards](https://github.com/Fractal-Techware/grafana-dashboards?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=infra-overview).

**Our other free dashboards on grafana.com.** Dashboards → New → Import, paste the ID:

- `25799` — **Kubernetes Namespaces & Pods**, namespace/pod CPU, memory and what is stuck
- `25835` — **VPS Host (node_exporter)**, one server in depth, incl. OOM kills and inodes
- `25836` — **n8n Production Overview**, n8n in queue mode: workers, backlog, failures

**When one of these panels goes red**, there is a free runbook for each of 165 Prometheus alerts — what it means, what it breaks and the commands to diagnose it: [fractaltechware.com/runbooks](https://fractaltechware.com/runbooks?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=infra-overview).

Need more than this? The paid pack adds 12 more dashboards across its tiers — Kubernetes cluster, nodes, namespaces and workloads, application RED metrics, blackbox endpoints, container runtime, Loki logs, capacity planning, alert operations and an SRE summary — plus Prometheus and Grafana alert rules, Terraform and Helm provisioning: [Grafana Observability Dashboard Pack](https://store.fractaltechware.com/l/grafana-dashboard-pack?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=infra-overview).
